settings.heading: SIZE & FIT
settings.content: Boxy oversized streetwear cut. Available in XS, S, M, L, XL, and XXL. Take your true size for a relaxed drop-shoulder fit, or size down for a standard fit.

settings.heading: FABRIC & CARE
settings.content: 100% combed heavyweight 280GSM cotton. High-density custom screen print. Machine wash cold inside out and hang dry to preserve graphic detail.

settings.heading: SHIPPING & RETURNS
settings.content: Worldwide tracked shipping dispatches within 1–2 business days. Unworn pieces in original condition may be returned or exchanged within 30 days.
